title: Adversarial Robustness for Deployed Models

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Adversarial Robustness for Deployed Models": Measure and improve robustness of production classifiers (fraud, malware, vision) to evasion, poisoning and extraction attacks. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Non-adaptive attacks only.
